sharper_kernel_endpoint_followup.status: Checked after the original one-dimensional deficit was observed; not an anticipated target in that run.
sharper_kernel_endpoint_followup.justification: On X=(-w*z,1,z), every boundary row has constant term kappa*(k-e1), k=(-w,0,v)/(v-w). The actual scalar-kernel condition R2=0 forces kappa=0, hence R1=O(z), and B_w has the additional X2 factor. This paper argument supplies the uniform bound; this check verifies its endpoint in the recorded matrices.
